title: Motif Recurrence and Rereading
goal: Trace recurring symbols and circular structure using volver a + infinitive in contrast with volver sobre + noun.
grammar: volver a + infinitive for textual recurrence vs volver sobre + noun for revisiting a theme or motif

items: I can use volver a + infinitive (including passive se vuelve a leer) to trace motif recurrence and rereading.
I can use volver sobre + noun to describe how an essay or reader revisits a theme or passage.
I can analyse structural echoes (el símbolo, la relectura, releer, resonar, entrelazar, la cadencia, el espejo).
